import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import z3
import analyze, infer, genbig

diag = []
orig_model = infer._Program.model
def wmodel(self, extra=()):
    sol = self._sol
    if sol is None or self._age >= infer._REFRESH:
        sol = self._fresh()
    age = self._age
    start = time.process_time()
    model = self._check(sol, extra)
    dt = time.process_time() - start
    if dt > 0.3 and age and not diag:
        diag.append((self, list(extra)))
        print('SLOW CHECK: %.3fs age=%d expr=%s' % (dt, age, str(extra[0])[:60]))
        # (a) retry on a fresh solver in the same context
        t0 = time.process_time()
        s2 = self._fresh()
        m2 = self._check(s2, extra)
        print('  retry same context:  %.3fs -> %s' % (time.process_time() - t0, m2 is not None))
        # (b) retry in a brand-new context with the same constraints
        t0 = time.process_time()
        nctx = z3.Context()
        s3 = z3.Solver(ctx=nctx)
        s3.add(self.cons)
        s3.add(extra)
        r = s3.check()
        print('  retry new context:  %.3fs -> %s' % (time.process_time() - t0, r == z3.sat))
        return model
    return model
infer._Program.model = wmodel

x = genbig.gen(2, 'narrow')
t0 = time.process_time()
analyze.process_line(json.dumps(x, separators=(',', ':')).encode())
print('total %.2fs' % (time.process_time() - t0))
PYEOF
